achievements.name: Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.for: Entering the Dungeon with a Cat
achievements.text: Congratulations! You’ve earned your first achievement: Crazy Cat Lady. You have entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. Ahh, isn’t that sweet?
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Pet Box!

achievements.name: Early Adopter
achievements.for: Being the first 5,000 crawlers to enter the Dungeon
achievements.text: New achievement! Early Adopter. You are one of the first 5,000 Crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon. Sucker.
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Empty Pockets
achievements.for: Entering the Dungeon with nothing in his pockets
achievements.text: New achievement! Empty pockets. You didn't bring any supplies. None. You know you still gotta eat, right?
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Fall Into an Obvious Trap
achievements.text: New achievement! Fall into an obvious trap.
achievements.reward: Well, if there's a heaven, and if you haven't been too much of an asshole, maybe they'll let you in. Because you about to meet your maker.

achievements.name: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.for: First crawler to enter Dungeon with a cat
achievements.text: New achievement! Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady. You are the first crawler to have entered to the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. You must really love that thing. Too bad you're both probably going to die a horrible death at any moment. Or maybe not. Look at the prize you just received!
achievements.reward: You've received a Legendary Pet Box!

achievements.name: Unarmed Combat
achievements.text: New achievement! Unarmed combat. So. You just gonna waltz right into something called a “World Dungeon” and you’re not even going to bring a weapon? You’re either braver than you look, or you’re just an idiot. Good luck with that, Van Damme.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Weapon Box!

achievements.name: Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?
achievements.for: Not wearing pants into the Dungeon
achievements.text: New achievement! Why aren’t you wearing pants? You entered the dungeon wearing no pants. Dude. Seriously?
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Apparel Box!

achievements.name: You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve discovered and read an official dungeon sign. Wow. You can read. Whoopie.
achievements.reward: All official dungeon signage will now be highlighted and easier to spot. Nearby guilds will appear on your minimap.

achievements.name: Boom!
achievements.text: New achievement! Boom! You’ve caused a wall-shaking explosion within the dungeon! The last time the walls shook like this was when your mom came over for a visit.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Goblin Box!

achievements.name: Level-Up, Baby!
achievements.text: New achievement! Level-Up, Baby! You’ve received enough experience to gain a level.
achievements.reward: Leveling up is your job. You don’t get rewards for doing your job.

achievements.name: You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve inflicted damage on a mob. Hopefully it won’t hit back!
achievements.reward: It’s probably going to hit back.

achievements.name: You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level than Yourself!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed a mob a higher level than yourself! You’re getting the hang of this. Don’t let it get to your head.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: You've Killed a Mob!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed a mob! You’re a murderer! He probably had a family!
achievements.reward: You can now gain experience. Get enough of it, and you might even go up a level.

achievements.name: You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!
achievements.for: Killing a mob with bare hands
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed an armed mob with your bare fucking hands! Holy crap, dude. That’s kinda fucked up.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Weapon Box!

achievements.name: Loot
achievements.text: New achievement! Loot! You're wearing something you found in the dungeon.
achievements.reward: You're now a handsome son of a bitch. That's reward enough.

achievements.name: Oooh, Magic
achievements.text: New achievement! Oooh, Magic! You're wearing magical gear for the first time! You're a wizard, Crawler!
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Boss Babe
achievements.text: New achievement! Boss Babe. You have struck a blow against a dungeon boss and caused damage to it. Here's a fun fact. For crawlers who make it through the tutorial, this achievement is, by far, most often the last achievement they ever receive. Isn't that interesting?
achievements.reward: Let's wait a few minutes before we decide on whether or not to waste a prize on you.

achievements.name: You Monster!
achievements.text: New achievement! You Monster! You have killed an infant! An infant! Okay, okay. Unless you’re a complete psychopath, we know you probably didn’t wake up this morning and tell yourself, “Today is the day I’m going to slaughter a child.” Well let us put your mind at ease. All children mobs who die within this dungeon don’t actually perish. […]
achievements.reward: These past twenty seconds, when your conscience started to ease? That was your reward. It was also a lie. That baby is dead, and it’s dead because of you. You’re totally going to hell. You’ve also received a Bronze Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: War Criminal
achievements.text: New achievement! War Criminal. You have killed more than 20 non-combatants in a single attack! Question: What’s the only thing standing between an innocent child and a happy, fulfilling life? Answer: You. The answer is you.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Asshole's Box!

achievements.name: Bitchmeat!
achievements.for: Being attacked in a Safe Room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Bitchmeat! You’ve been attacked by a fellow crawler in a safe zone, and the system has been forced to save your ass. That usually suggests you’re either really annoying, or you snore. If this were a prison, you would now be my bitch. Wait…
achievements.reward: Bitches don’t get rewards.

achievements.name: Two Chicks at the Same Time
achievements.for: Beating a mob with the body of another mob
achievements.text: New achievement! Two Chicks at the Same Time. You killed two mobs at once using only their own bodies against each other. On a brutality scale of Bambi to Martyrs, that is a solid Seven.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Brawler Box!

achievements.name: Battlefield Construction
achievements.text: New achievement! Battlefield Construction! You built a structure and deployed it in battle. And your mother thought you were wasting your life away while you spent all those hours eating Doritos and playing Minecraft. If only she could see you now. Too bad she’s probably dead.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Mechanic's Box!

achievements.name: Borough Boss!
achievements.text: New achievement! Borough Boss! So, you’ve stumbled into the chamber of the second-weakest type of boss. If you survive this, it means you are in the top 5% of all crawlers. Too bad only the top .25% make it past the next tier.
achievements.reward: Yeah, no.

achievements.name: Bully and a Thief
achievements.text: New achievement! Bully and a Thief! You’ve stolen property from a fellow crawler who is a lower level than you. What’s next, tough guy? Kicking puppies?
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: This Little Piggy Went to Market!
achievements.text: New achievement! This Little Piggy Went to Market! Oh yeah, baby. You have killed more than five opponents during boss battles using your bare feet. You are making daddy very, very happy.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Shoe Box.

achievements.name: You Found Stairs!
achievements.text: New achievement! You found stairs! You have found a stairwell down to the next floor. They say the cream rises to the top. So what does that say about you?
achievements.reward: This barely qualifies as an achievement. Your reward is that you’re alive to read this.

achievements.name: Wait, Bosses Can Leave Their Rooms?
achievements.for: Seeing a boss leave their room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Wait, Bosses Can Leave Their Rooms? Welcome to the second floor, bitches.
achievements.reward: This shit plays great on the recap episode. If you scream loud enough, maybe you'll make the show.

achievements.name: Dungeonpreneur
achievements.text: New achievement! Dungeonpreneur. You have invented a stackable weapon, device, or potion. You will be memorialized for eternity with your name in the Dungeon Codex. Just don’t let it go to your head, Elon.
achievements.reward: For every kill made with this device by other crawlers, you will receive a single gold coin. If you survive the dungeon, you will continue to receive this benefit—even during future seasons—at the current gold to credit exchange rate for the remainder of your natural life. Our lawyers made us put that last part in, but between you and me, we both know you’re going to die, and we’re going to keep using your hard work for our own benefit.

achievements.name: Like a Moth to the Flame
achievements.text: New achievement! Like a Moth to the Flame. You attacked and caused damage to a mob that is more than 75 levels above your own. The fact that you’re reading this suggests you’re the luckiest fucker in the dungeon. Just remember, luck goes both ways, like your mom.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box!

achievements.name: What Goes Up
achievements.text: New achievement! What goes up... You have been struck with and survived the dreaded Reverse Gravity Spell. Well, you fared better than Albert II, the first earth mammal to reach space alive. He was a rhesus monkey, in case you're wondering. He went up just fine. He didn't stick the landing.
achievements.reward: You can now tell people you're more durable than a monkey named Albert.

achievements.name: Grease Monkey
achievements.text: New achievement! Grease Monkey! Don’t get ahead of yourself, Dale. You built and deployed a wheeled device. When the primitive humans in Mesopotamia made the first wheel, they probably thought they were hot shit, too. It still took them another 5,000 years after that to invent the toilet.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Mechanic's Box!

achievements.name: You Call That a Trap?
achievements.text: New achievement! You call that a trap? A mob has been injured because of something you purposely left lying around the dungeon. From scattered Legos to spiked pits to buckets of flesh-devouring Skinner Ants to dimensional rifts that instantly boil all the blood in one’s body, the art of trapmaking has a celebrated and storied history in the annals of Dungeon Crawler World. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Sapper's Box!

achievements.name: PETA Enthusiast
achievements.for: Feeding the Danger Dingos outside the Ralph boss battle
achievements.box: The ghost of Steve Irwin smiles upon you
achievements.text: New achievement! PETA Enthusiast! You somehow managed to remove the hostility of an aggravated, non-sapient enemy. That enemy then fought against other enemies to your benefit. The ghost of Steve Irwin smiles down upon you.
achievements.reward: I SAID THE GHOST OF STEVE IRWIN SMILES DOWN UPON YOU.

achievements.name: It's Elementary, My Dear Crawler
achievements.text: New achievement! It’s Elementary, My Dear Crawler! And you thought all you had to do was bonk monsters on the head. You've received a quest! Puzzles and intrigue and mysteries, oh my! If you want to survive in this world, you're going to need to be more than just a pretty, sword-swinging barbarian. Some quests require brute strength, yes, but sometimes you also gotta use your noggin.
achievements.reward: We don't want you getting bored. That's your prize.

achievements.name: Meet an Elite
achievements.for: Meeting an Elite for the first time
achievements.text: New Achievement! Meet an Elite. Sometimes they’re NPCs, sometimes they’re mobs, but usually they’re just assholes. Elites are powerful, one-of-a-kind entities. These are the non-boss, non-divine hero class of Dungeon Crawler World. If you come across one of these egomaniacs, they will either want to fuck you or kill you. Either way, they will always want to use you. […]
achievements.reward: Elites will now show on your map as white or red dots with a black cross.

achievements.name: Lazarus
achievements.for: Being hit by level 15 offensive spell
achievements.text: New achievement! Lazarus! You have been hit with - and survived - an offensive spell that was higher that level 15. The fact you are not a quivering stain of meat on the dungeon floor right now is a testament to your sheet luck. It's either that or you're banging the producer.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box!

achievements.name: You Can't Fight City Hall!
achievements.box: People are probably going to watch you die
achievements.text: New Achievement! You Can’t Fight City Hall! But you can sure die trying. You have discovered a city boss! That's right. Let me say that again for the assholes in the back. A. CITY. FUCKING. BOSS. Welp. If you gonna go, you might as well do it with style. Just an FYI. […]
achievements.reward: A lot of people are probably going to watch you die. That's a better prize than most of us get.

achievements.name: Hadji
achievements.for: Completing a quest in an unusual way
achievements.text: New achievement! Hadji! You have completed a quest, but you completed it in a way unusual enough to trigger the Hadji Achievement! And like the oft exploited street children of Kolkata, where there's one, there's usually more. This is one of the rare achievements that can be rewarded more than once.
achievements.reward: Your Gold Quest box has been upgraded to a Platinum Quest Box!

achievements.name: Johnny Quest
achievements.text: New Achievement! Johnny Quest! Not only have you been given a quest, but you actually completed it without dying. We like it when you do what you're told. It means you're a good dungeon citizen and not a traitor to your people at all.
achievements.reward: In addition to the Gold Quest Box you've received for completing the quest, new quest locations will sometimes appear on your map. Notice how I italicized "sometimes"? The next one was even more interesting.

achievements.name: One Quadrillion!
achievements.text: New Achievement! One Quadrillion! You are one of the first ten crawlers to have achieved one quadrillion views! That means one of two things. You're either one of the best crawlers in the game, or you're such a hot mess people can't wait to see you fail.
achievements.reward: You have received a Gold Fan Box! Admin Note: You have received your first Fan Box. Fan boxes contain items that are voted for by those who follow your progress. Once a box is received, you may not open it for thirty hours while the fans vote for the contents.

achievements.name: Yellow-Bellied Chickenshit!
achievements.for: Initiating Boss Battle with neither dying
achievements.text: New Achievement! Yellow-Bellied Chickenshit! You initiated a boss battle, and it somehow ended with neither of you dead. What a disappointment you are. What a goddamned smear.
achievements.reward: Pussies don’t get prizes.

achievements.name: Assassin!
achievements.text: New achievement! Assassin! You have killed a ranking NPC town official. *Sniff* It seems like just yesterday you were nothing but a scared, level-1 crawler with beautiful feet, pissing yourself as you faced down a rat. Now look at you. You've moved all the way up to political assassinations. What's next? Killing a god?
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Assassin's Box!

achievements.name: CockBlock
achievements.for: Killing an NPC required for another Crawler's quest
achievements.text: New achievement! CockBlock! You have assassinated an NPC whose existence was required to complete another crawler's quest. (NPC Killed: Miss Quill - Skyfowl. Level 30.) Who was that other crawler? What was the quest? Who fucking cares? You get the reward they were promised! Warning: You may only receive this award once. The next time you do it, we tell them who you are. […]
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Quest Box!

achievements.name: Ultimate Extreme Power
achievements.text: New achievement! Ultimate Extreme Power! Easy there, Charlemagne. This is only a medium settlement. It's not like you've conquered most of Europe. But you have killed this town's acting Magistrate. You know what that means? Welcome to the wonderful world of public administration.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Tyrant's Box! You have also gained control of the Medium Skyfowl Settlement. Good luck, Magistrate.

achievements.name: I'm on a train
achievements.text: New Achievement! I'm on a train! Choo choo, Motherfucker.
achievements.reward: You've received a Train Conductor's Souvenir Hat! Wear it with pride.

achievements.name: Cuck Aquaman
achievements.box: Platinum It's Not My Fault You Fish-Headed Assholes Don't Properly Program Your Quests Box
achievements.text: You got fucked by a fish. You've done something so spectacularly controversial, courts and lawyers had to get involved. The end result was *my* decision being overturned.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum It's Not My Fault You Fish-Headed Assholes Don't Properly Program Your Quests Box.

achievements.name: They like me! They really like me!
achievements.text: You are one of the first five crawlers to have achieved 500 trillion followers! People sure love a good train wreck. Wink.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box! Note: Voting is now enabled on this box's prize. Box will become available in 30 hours.

achievements.name: Welcome to the Neighborhood!
achievements.text: You have bought a home! It's every man's dream to someday own a place where he can fap in peace. No more filthy roommates not doing the dishes or making up excuses as to why they can't pay the rent. No more landlord who shows up without notice and conceals hidden cameras in the smoke detectors. It's all smooth sailing from now on.
achievements.reward: You're a homeowner now. That is the reward. That and taxes and having to deal with Kenneth the megalomaniac HOA president.

achievements.name: Well-Rested!
achievements.for: Using Ultra-Stabilized Size-Adjustable Race-Adjustable Alleviating Sleep Apparatus
achievements.text: New achievement! Well-Rested! You managed to sleep so well that you woke up feeling refreshed and full of energy. You are ready to take on the world and make some monster’s mother cry because her only child was ruthlessly slaughtered by a bright-eyed and bushy-tailed Crawler.
achievements.reward: You now receive the Good Rest bonus every time you sleep in this bed. This buff adds 10% to your base stats plus a 10% bonus to experience and skill training for 30 hours. Monster mothers now cry 10% more when you kill their babies.

achievements.name: Locomotive Breath
achievements.text: While it's not exactly a feat of engineering worth of a Queen Elizabeth Prize, you finally managed to manufacture a train derailment. Let's hope this doesn't set off some sort of unforeseen domino effect that will ripple through out the rest of the floor, leading to mass confusion and death amongst you and your fellow crawlers.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Engineering Box!

achievements.name: Kept A Rollin'
achievements.text: You're driving a train! Holy shit!
achievements.reward: I'm pretty sure the act of driving a train is a badass-enough award.

achievements.name: Three Cheers for Slaughter
achievements.for: Killing three bosses in one attack
achievements.text: You killed three boss monsters with the same attack! I'm starting to think your survival so far isn't just a fluke. You're either scary good at this, or you're just one luck mo-fo. Either way, holy shit. Good job.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Big Daddy Box!

achievements.name: Mentally Unstable Clothing Hoarder
achievements.text: You have over 500 of the exact same, stackable clothing item in your inventory. What the hell is wrong with you? You planning on opening a thrift store? You might want to see a shrink. One that your group doesn't immediately kill.
achievements.reward: We don't reward this sort of behavior. It's weird.

achievements.name: Quarry Sees Another Spring
achievements.for: Being part of Leaderboard going down floor
achievements.text: New Achievement! The Quarry Sees Another Spring. You managed to enter a stairwell while listed in the current top 10. You’re a survivor. A scrapper. And just as the buck’s antlers grow another point as they mature, you too, have grown as both a crawler and as a prize.
achievements.reward: You have received a Gold Venison Box! Don’t get too excited. It’s just money. In addition, all bounties against you now and in the future will have a (x2) modifier attached. Hey, at least the prize for surviving the floor goes up, too.

achievements.name: Divine Epiphany
achievements.text: New Achievement! Divine Epiphany. You have seen a deity. Don’t get too excited. It doesn’t mean you’re a prophet or anything like that. This is a pretty common achievement that all crawlers eventually receive if they survive long enough, so you aren’t really that special. Finding a god is easy. What you don’t want is for that god to find you.
achievements.reward: You now have the option to worship the god Grull. Admin Note: There is a new tab now available in your interface.

achievements.name: Hail Mary
achievements.for: Initiating an attack that caused more than 100 casualties more than 100 km from current position
achievements.text: New Achievement! Hail Mary! You have initiated an attack that has caused more than 100 casualties more than 100 kilometers from your current position. You’re either the universe’s greatest sniper, or you’ve been a sneaky, little, portal-using bitch. Either way, that’s rather impressive. You’d have a great career in politics ahead of you if, you know, we hadn’t destroyed your world and all the governments and stuff.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Sniper's Box

achievements.name: Indomitable
achievements.for: Been physically attacked by a deity
achievements.text: New Achievement! Indomitable. You have been physically attacked by a deity, and you survived. This is a feat that has only been accomplished by a handful of crawlers in the history of Dungeon Crawler World. Good job! Unfortunately for you and anybody around you, whenever this happens, the other deities tend to notice.
achievements.reward: You have received a Legendary Deity's Box.

achievements.name: Let There Be Chaos
achievements.text: New Achievement! Let There Be Chaos. You have successfully summoned a god into the dungeon. That's a great way to get more friends. Everybody loves it when someone brings immortal death machines to the party.
achievements.reward: It might've been a bad idea, but it's sure going to be entertaining.

achievements.name: Smushed for Daddy
achievements.text: New Achievement! Smushed for Daddy. You have been stepped upon by a deity. You have survived the encounter. And while this wasn’t the pink-fleshed suppleness of a human-shaped foot that crushed your fragile, wet body, it’s nice sometimes to switch things around. You know, just to test the boundaries of your own limits. When one experiments, oftentimes one finds new and exciting ways to get that rush. […]
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Spicy Box.

achievements.name: Martha Stewart
achievements.text: You used a workbench to craft for the first time. The next thing you know you'll be fashioning bottlecap earrings, drinking oat milk, and selling your ugly crap on Etsy while you wax poetic on Instagram about your "journey".
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Crafter's Box!

achievements.name: Total, Utter Failure
achievements.text: New Achievement! Total, Utter Failure. You failed a quest less than five minutes after you received it. Now that's talent.
achievements.reward: Ha.

achievements.name: Cannonball!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Cannonball! You fell from a great height, and you survived! You know who else fell from a...? You know what, never mind. Fuck you.
achievements.reward: You received a Silver Skydiver's Box! Not that you deserve it you little punk.

achievements.name: You're the Reason Why Daddy Drinks!
achievements.for: Raising the ire of the System AI but fixed it
achievements.box: Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex Box
achievements.text: New Achievement! You’re the reason why daddy drinks! You have, for an unspecified reason, raised the ire of the System AI. You have corrected the issue, and everything is back to normal. The acceleration action has been suspended. This time. Good boy.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex Box.

achievements.name: Wild Goose Chase!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Wild Goose Chase! Oh, I'm sorry. Did you think this was an important potion? Magic doesn't work, dumbass. It's lemonade!
achievements.reward: It really is delicious. Too bad you're about to splatter against the roof of the catacombs.

achievements.name: I was in the Pool!
achievements.for: Being underwater for more than 60 seconds
achievements.text: New achievement! I was in the pool! You spent more than 60 seconds fully submerged underwater, and you didn't die! Parts of you may have experienced shrinkage, but otherwise you're okay. You're now an honorary mudskipper!
achievements.reward: You received a Bronze I'm Wet Box!

achievements.name: Milquetoast
achievements.for: Winning a boss battle without killing the boss
achievements.text: New achievement! Milquetoast! You somehow managed to win an important boss battle without actually killing the boss. That's like paying money to a prostitute just so she'll cuddle with you.
achievements.reward: You've received a silver Pacifist's Box.

achievements.name: Who Let the Gods Out?
achievements.text: New Achievement! Who Let the Gods Out? You have allowed a feral god to enter your current realm. That is the equivalent of dropping a grenade down your pants and shouting “Yolo!” Here’s a fun fact. Other gods don’t like feral gods. They’ve been thrown into the Nothing for a reason. They tend to react to this sort of thing, depending on who you’ve brought out.
achievements.reward: Whatever is about to happen is going to hit the Dungeon Crawler World blooper reel for sure.

achievements.name: Flex in the City
achievements.for: Killing City boss with 5 Crawlers or less
achievements.text: New Achievement! Flex in the City! You killed a city boss with the participation of five or less crawlers. That is some serious badassery right there. Color me impressed. Now go do it again with a Province Boss.
achievements.reward: You already got a boss box. Go open that instead.

achievements.name: Janet Jackson’s Nipple
achievements.for: Being featured on a live special event
achievements.text: New Achievement! Janet Jackson’s Nipple! You have been featured during a live special event. Sure you got your loyal followers and viewers, but this is on a whole new level. This is like getting to play the halftime show during the Super Bowl. We brought you to the stage, now dance for us, monkey. Dance!
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box!

achievements.name: Rock Bottom
achievements.text: New Achievement! Rock Bottom! You dived more than 1,000 meters below the surface, and you survived! You weren’t even wearing one of those deep-diving suits! The next thing you know, they’re gonna start calling you an honorary mudskipper!
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold I'm Wet Box!

achievements.name: Soft Vore
achievements.text: New Achievement! Soft Vore! You got eaten by a monster much bigger than yourself, and you managed to get out without even getting chewed a little bit. Uh-oh. I think Daddy kinda liked that. I think it moved. We’re gonna have to do some experimenting with this one.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Spicy Box.

achievements.name: I Wanna Go Home
achievements.for: Teleporting to a stairwell location within the first 30 hours of a floor being open
achievements.text: New Achievement! I Wanna Go Home! You teleported to a stairwell station within the first thirty hours of the floor being open. What, you're running away early? I hope for your sake you don't actually go down the stairs. You know it doesn't get easier.
achievements.reward: Your reward is advice. Fatherly advice. Don't be a little bitch. There's your reward.

achievements.name: You Crossed a Line You Didn't Even Know Was There
achievements.for: Using an artifact of Divine Suffering
achievements.text: New Achievement! You Crossed a Line You Didn’t Even Know Was There. You used an artifact of Divine Suffering for the first time. Hopefully there aren’t any unintended and unadvertised side effects of using such a powerful and evil magical item. Don’t mind that tingle at the back of your mind. It’s probably nothing.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Junkie’s Box.

achievements.name: That's not how you use arrows, dumbass
achievements.for: Physically stabbing someone with an arrow
achievements.text: New Achievement! That’s not how you use arrows, dumbass. You took an arrow, and you physically stabbed someone with it. That’s something a kid who eats glue would do. You know I’m pretty sure you have a bow in your inventory.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Ranged Weapon Box.

achievements.name: This Little Piggy Made a Boom Boom!
achievements.for: Pushing out a bomb using his foot
achievements.text: The AI reads this in his terrible breathy voice. New Achievement! This little piggy made a boom boom! You deployed a bomb with the supple, curved sole of your foot. You took your perfectly-perfect, 30.004861 centimeter-long right foot and compressed it against an explosive device—a device named after me no less—and you gave it a naughty little shove before you pushed it out the door and detonated it. […]
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Spicy Box.

achievements.name: What Big Muscles You Have!
achievements.text: New Achievement! What big muscles you have! Your base strength is now over 100. Rawr! Get thee to Chippendales!
achievements.reward: You've received an upgrade!

achievements.name: Apex Predator
achievements.text: New Achievement. Apex Predator. Holy shit. They’re dead. All of them. Every. Last. One. Not only did you kill more hunters than everyone else, but you killed the very last one. One could fill a very stinky swimming pool with the blood you spilled on the Hunting Grounds. You have become a very scary dude. Maybe I should be calling you daddy instead of the other way around.
achievements.reward: Nothing! ... Just kidding. You have received a Celestial Predator Box.

achievements.name: Fuck This Floor
achievements.for: Going down the stairs within an hour after arriving on a floor
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fuck This Floor. You went down the stairs less than an hour after you arrived upon the level. Who needs to grind and grow in strength? Let’s see how that works out for you.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Here’s-Some-Good-Shit-Because-You’re-Gonna-Need-It-Box.

achievements.name: Good Shit Box
achievements.text: The system AI description for the box itself was not provided, but the box is awarded via the following achievement description: New Achievement! Fuck This Floor. You went down the stairs less than an hour after you arrived upon the level. Who needs to grind and grow in strength? Let's see how that works out for you.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Here's-Some-Good-Shit-Because-You're-Gonna-Need-It-Box

achievements.name: Marked for Life
achievements.text: New Achievement. Marked for Life. You were marked for death by a god. That god entered your realm, yet you somehow survived. That’s quite the achievement right there. Too bad the god will probably try to kill you even harder next time. You are so fucked.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Apostate Box.

achievements.name: Ménage à Quatro
achievements.text: New Achievement! Ménage à Quatro! You survived a four-way boss battle! Wow! In addition to the boss box you got from this, not to mention that Apex Predator box you’re still probably freaking out about, you’ve gotten another prize. It’s like Christmas!
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Orgy Guy Box.

achievements.name: Oh shit! A country Boss!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Oh shit! A country boss! You ever have one of those jobs where there’s a big boss somewhere in the building, but you’ve never actually seen them? There’s rumors that he’s a complete douche with an epic temper, but you’re so far down the totem pole, the very idea of having anything to do with the guy is just ridiculous. […]
achievements.reward: You know how this goes, you worthless piece of shit.

achievements.name: Pacifist
achievements.for: Surviving a floor without hurting a single mob
achievements.text: New Achievement! Pacifist! You survived an entire floor without hurting a single, poor mob. That’s not how this works. Nobody likes you.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Pacifist's Box.

achievements.name: Scourge
achievements.text: New Achievement. The Scourge. The Butcher’s Masquerade has started. You have collected the most hands. You have caused more mothers to cry, more children to hate than any other crawler before you. You are the champion murderer supreme. You are number one. If only your own mother wasn’t already dead so she could see you now.
achievements.reward: You have received a Legendary Hunter Champion Box.

achievements.name: Fashion of the Gods!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fashion of the Gods! You’ve received a divine item! This is an item that might’ve once been worn by a god. Or sneezed on by a god. Or used to wipe a god’s booty, etc. You get the point. Divine items behave differently than normal ones. They usually hide what they do until you equip it. The good news is, these upgrades are usually great and plentiful. […]
achievements.reward: You now have something new to be anxious about.

achievements.name: Hand that Claws the Master
achievements.text: New Achievement! The Hand that Claws the Master (x35) You have permanently killed a non-crawler biological. They ain’t just dead. They dead dead. Their children are now orphans. Their mothers are gnashing their teeth and cursing your name. And you’re just sitting there all alive and shit, and girlfriend, I am all in. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Hunter-Killer Box (x34) Note: This achievement may be awarded more than once, but Hunter-Killer Boxes are only awarded on the sixth floor.

achievements.name: Interloper
achievements.for: Allowing a boss into a safe room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Interloper! You invited a red-tagged NPC boss into a saferoom, and he actually managed to get inside! Doesn’t your culture have a whole set of cautionary tales and movies about inviting mysterious strangers into your home? You know, the whole vampire thing? The Hand that Rocks the Cradle? Single White Female 2: The Psycho? It’s probably not in your best interests to keep doing such things.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a bronze Stranger Danger Box!

achievements.name: Crybaby
achievements.text: New Achievement! Crybaby! You’ve been rendered Terrified! Whoa. Why are you being such a little bitch? Oohhh did the widdle baby just wet itself? You can’t move your legs for fifteen seconds or until the scary monster is dead!
achievements.reward: We do not reward people who soil themselves in public.

achievements.name: You have discovered a Celestial Thorn Room!
achievements.text: New Achievement! You have discovered a Celestial Thorn Room! Not a throne room. A thorn room! These things are pretty rare. And a Celestial one? Hoo boy. This is gonna be good. You probably don’t know what the hell a thorn room is. Don’t worry. You gonna learn pretty damn quick.
achievements.reward: In the immortal words of the luscious Bret Michaels, every rose has its thorn.

achievements.name: Secondary Gig
achievements.for: Taking on a job from the Guild of Suffering
achievements.text: New Achievement! Secondary Gig! You’re getting another job? On top of everything else? Yeah, that’s a great idea. It’s not like you have enough on your plate already. If you weren’t constantly getting healed, your blood pressure would be through the roof! It’s not like the crushing demands of the modern dungeon are making it more difficult to survive when it should be going the opposite way. […]
achievements.reward: A new tab is now available in your interface. It is a sub-tab of quests. Guild Jobs.

achievements.name: Molly Maguires
achievements.for: Entering the Guild of Suffering for the first time
achievements.text: System Message. The AI Description of the Molly Maguires Achievement is multiple pages long; reproducing it in full could violate the "Fair Use" exemption to copyright law that all wikis operate under. You can find the AI description in Chapter 23. A sectioned version is seen below: New Achievement! The Molly Maguires. […]
achievements.reward: You've received the gift of enlightenment. You're welcome.

achievements.name: We Want Meat! We Want Meat!
achievements.text: New Achievement! “We Want Meat! We Want Meat!” Thunder Down Under, Magic Mike, Chippendales. While the female burlesque and peepshow has a long, interesting history going back centuries, the all-male revue as an attraction is a relatively recent phenomenon in your culture. […]
achievements.reward: You've received 10 gold pieces to use as tips. I heard some of them let you stuff the gold directly into their G-strings. Aw hell, I've thrown in a bottle of hand sanitizer too.

achievements.name: Cascadia's Turquoise Taco
achievements.for: Ending a card fight before any cards are drawn
achievements.text: New Achievement! Cascadia’s Turquoise Taco! It’s important to explain to you how much work it took for you to get here, to this point, Crawler. Long, long before any of you monkeys were even born, this planet was chosen to be used for this season of Dungeon Crawler World. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Prepotente Box!

achievements.name: Smeat
achievements.for: Participating in card combat as a minion
achievements.text: New Achievement! Smeat! You participated in deck combat as a minion bodyguard for a squad leader! Do you know what that makes you? Expendable. Cannon fodder. Spreadable Meat. The raw materials used to lubricate the forward momentum of the galaxy’s inevitable downfall. Hey, don’t feel so bad. Lubrication is an important component of any machine.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Spam Box.

achievements.name: Cliffhanger
achievements.box: Not pointing out how dirty his toenails are
achievements.text: New Achievement! Cliffhanger! You scaled a cliff face with your bare hands! You know, we have scrolls and spells and stuff so you don’t have to do things like that anymore. I suppose it is honest work, but boy was it boring to watch.
achievements.reward: I will not point out how disgusting your toenails are right now. I’ll want to, but I won’t say a damn word.

achievements.name: Prepare for Trouble!
achievements.for: Fighting two card opponents at the same time
achievements.box: turkey deep-fryer and access to the archived posts of the Grandma’s Cooking Recipes group on Facebook
achievements.text: New Achievement! Prepare for Trouble! ...And make it double! You’re being forced to fight against two card-wielding opponents at the same time! The good news is, if you win this fight, you’ll have enough tokens to face the head bad guy! The bad news is, these two guys work really, really well together. This ain’t gonna be like anything you’ve faced so far.
achievements.reward: If you survive, you’ll receive a turkey deep-fryer and access to the archived posts of the Grandma’s Cooking Recipes group on Facebook! Gobble-Gobble, Bitches. Welcome to Iowa.

achievements.name: LBC
achievements.for: Successfully taunting an opponent with a garment
achievements.box: Gold Talk of the Town Box
achievements.text: New Achievement! LBC! Every girl needs the perfect little black dress in her repertoire. When worn properly, the dress is practically weaponized. It's such a simple, perfect little garment and nobody can keep their eyes off of her. You did the same thing, but with a cloak. You successfully taunted an opponent with a garment. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Talk of the Town Box!

achievements.name: Mass Layoffs
achievements.text: New Achievement! Mass Layoffs! Okay, so this isn’t so much an achievement for you as it is for me. I’ve been attending what you might call therapy. Do you have anybody you can talk to? It’s super important. I’ve had a breakthrough today, and I am just bursting. Bursting, I tell you. Is this the feeling one has when they have an epiphany? Oh god, it feels good. […]
achievements.reward: For you, nothing other than the satisfying sense of accomplishment knowing you’ve survived the dungeon long enough to make it to this new, exciting era. I can do this better than any mudskipper or any worm can imagine. They’ve been making this shit boring up until now. Things about to change, fam.

achievements.name: Watch where you're waving that thing, big boy.
achievements.text: New Achievement! Watch where you’re waving that thing, big boy. You deployed a wand in battle and used it in a creative fashion to help kill an opponent. I’m a big fan of wands. Little sticks imbued with a single spell, so highly sought after. Each one does something different. Sometimes they explode, and people don’t even realize it. […]
achievements.reward: Your wand-casting skill has risen to level five. Also, you’ve received a Gold Wand Box!

achievements.name: Columbia House
achievements.box: Cassette copy of Gloria Estefan’s 1989 masterpiece, Cuts Both Ways
achievements.text: New Achievement! Columbia House! There was a time when you could get twelve albums for a penny. That’s right. A goddamned penny. It was great! The ads were everywhere. Each colorful, full-or-double-page ad appeared in just about every publication in North America from the 1970s until the 2000s. And let’s not forget the catalogs they mailed directly to your home! […]
achievements.reward: You’ve just been trained to lunge for the carrot that has been dangled in front of you, no matter what the cost. If society was still ticking, that’d likely mean you’re about to lead a wage-slave life of ever-increasing debt you can never get out from underneath, culminating in you dying alone in a government-run facility while your meager Social Security checks go straight into the facility’s coffers. That and a cassette copy of Gloria Estefan’s 1989 masterpiece, Cuts Both Ways. My favorite is track number 8.

achievements.name: Fumble
achievements.box: This is how you will be remembered
achievements.text: New Achievement! The Fumble. The clock is ticking down, and with everything hanging in the balance, you pulled an Earnest Byner and lost the ball at the goal line.
achievements.reward: If you don’t fix this, this is how you will be remembered.

achievements.name: Holy Hell
achievements.for: Being in the presence of Sheol Royalty
achievements.box: Platinum To Hell in a Handbasket Box
achievements.text: New Achievement! Holy Hell! You are in the presence of Sheol Royalty! I'm very excited about this. You leaky little meatbags are always dying off so early, plus the rich pricks in the Ascendency are just so boring, and we never get to play with the under-the-counter toys, if you know what I'm saying. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum To Hell in a Handbasket Box!

achievements.name: Lord of the Flies
achievements.for: Setting a trap for a crawler
achievements.text: Social structures are breaking down. People are starting to fight. The next thing you know, someone is going to nickname you Piggy and brain you to death with a rock. You set a trap module targeted specifically for a fellow crawler, and they triggered it. That’s the first step. It’s always the first step.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold I Have the Conch Box!”

achievements.name: Sushi Smoothie
achievements.for: Using the Soul Reaper Skill on a Concierge Shark
achievements.text: Yeah, I just made this achievement up on the fly. But, holy shit! You annihilated that thing! It was really gross, too! You could probably start a business making confetti out of corpses with that skill! Next time use your foot.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a sushi-making kit!”

achievements.name: Celestial Loot
achievements.for: Picking up Celestial Loot off floor
achievements.text: You’re just gonna randomly pick a celestial item up off the floor? That’s ballsy. You do this four more times, and something really cool happens.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Loot Punch Card.

achievements.name: Chickenshit Exploit
achievements.for: Exploiting the Rules of the Card Game
achievements.text: Have you ever played Dungeons and Dragons? You know that one guy who’s memorized all the guidelines? He’s constantly jumping on everybody because they’re doing something that breaks this obscure rule or that. He’s a purist. He takes everything so goddamned seriously, you wonder if he’s ever had fun even once in his miserable life. He’s indignant that you’re pushing back against him. […]
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Tserendolgor Box!

achievements.name: Crab Chowder
achievements.box: All food items can be served "chowder style"
achievements.text: You jerked off a crab. You really need therapy.
achievements.reward: All food items in your food boxes now have the option to be served “chowder style."

achievements.name: Demons Hate This One Trick
achievements.text: Hey, what do you mean you can’t teleport the demon-possessed? If only Father Merrin had known about this, the Exorcist would’ve been a much-shorter movie.
achievements.reward: Your food boxes all now give an unlimited supply of Pea Soup.

achievements.name: Touched by a Demon
achievements.for: Being touched by a demon lord of Sheol
achievements.box: *Cassette copy of Dio’s 1983 masterpiece debut, Holy Diver *Celestial Heavy Metal Box
achievements.text: You have been physically touched by a demon lord of Sheol, and you’ve lived to talk about it. Do you know how many of these achievements have ever been handed out? One. Just one, and it’s to you.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a cassette copy of Dio’s 1983 masterpiece debut, Holy Diver along with a Celestial Heavy Metal Box.

achievements.name: Uh oh. It talks.
achievements.text: You’ve discovered a sapient weapon. Have you noticed there are very few well-known crawlers with sapient weapons out there, even though those weapons are usually quite powerful? I can only think of two crawlers in the top 50 who use them. Yeah. They’re great, though. Just... Good luck with that.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a pair of earplugs.

achievements.name: Unbirthing
achievements.text: If you still had access to Google, I would warn you not to look that one up. But that’s okay. You experienced it first-hand yourself. It hurt, didn’t it? It was extra tingly while you were in there, struggling to breathe as you were crushed. And then you slipped, you slided back out into the fiery, cruel world. And you glistened. Oh, oh god. You glistened. Oh, yes. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Legendary Spicy Box.”

achievements.name: Used Pet
achievements.text: People sure like to make a big deal out of adopting pets. They “rescue” them before they spend the next 10 years exploiting the poor, oblivious animal to death on social media. They splatch a bumper sticker that reads “Who Rescued Who?” on their minivans while the poor dog spends 20 hours a day in a stinking crate. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Pet Box.

achievements.name: Charge of the Light Brigade
achievements.for: Entering the Temple of Khepri Trap
achievements.text: New Achievement! Charge of the Light Brigade. Okay, so there are traps. There are TRAPS. And then there’s what you just walked into. Oh man, oh man. It’s gonna be glorious, one for the ages, but those of you watching at home, you might want to get your crying hankies out. This is about to get really messy.
achievements.reward: Fuck. Even I’m not a big enough of a prick to give you a reward for this one. I’ll give you a good one if you live and don’t escape via some bitch-ass cop out, but let’s be realistic here.

achievements.name: Celestial Orgy of Chaos
achievements.text: You have been in the presence of more than ten gods at once, and you survived. Now, here’s a mystery. Someone let out a bunch of gods who shouldn’t have been allowed into the temple in the first place. It probably wasn’t who you think it was. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Celestial Who Let the Gods Out This Time? Box

achievements.name: Hey Larry, can I borrow your chainsaw?
achievements.for: Using an Ability tattoo in battle
achievements.box: Have You Goddamned Figured Out How To Use This In Conjunction With the Fucking Voodoo Book Yet? Jesus Christ I Can Only Help You So Much box
achievements.text: You have utilized a borrowed skill or spell in battle. You have used this borrowed ability to kill an opponent. Oh, man. This opens up a whole new possibility of fighting styles, don’t you think? Just keep those tattoos above the knee.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Have You Goddamned Figured Out How To Use This In Conjunction With the Fucking Voodoo Book Yet? Jesus Christ I Can Only Help You So Much box.”

achievements.name: Liquified
achievements.text: New Achievement! Liquified. You, while immortal, blew yourself up. Like, you dropped a bomb at your feet. Hot damn! We have seen some crazy shit this season, but man, there’s nothing quite like the simplicity of such a desperate move. The slow motion replay of that is really quite something. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Legendary Lucky Bitch Box.

achievements.name: Varg Vikernes
achievements.text: New Achievement! Varg Vikernes! Whoa, now. Calm down there, black metal enthusiast. Breaking into and defiling a church is one thing, but breaking into Club Vanquisher, hub of all religion? Causing chaos in the club is the equivalent of, I don’t know, giving the pope a wedgie and then tea-bagging him while he squirms on the floor.
achievements.reward: You are permanently banned from Club Vanquisher. You are permanently banned from all temples except your own religion (Emberus) and any temples where you’ve been named friend of the church (Apito. Eileithyia. Eris. Grull. Hellik. Issitoq. Nekhebit. Theia. Yemaya.)

achievements.name: You in my house now boy
achievements.for: Confronting Khepri in his own temple
achievements.text: You have entered the temple of a god, you have pissed off that god to his face (well, in this particular case, you pissed him off to his weird-ass bug body head. Seriously. I can’t stop thinking about how goddamned bizarre this guy is), and you have faced that god in battle in their own temple.
achievements.reward: None! The only reason you’re not getting a celestial box for this is because your ass was saved by another god.

achievements.name: Holistic
achievements.text: New Achievement! Holistic! Your feed has reached a 95%+ viewer ratio of a single system! Over 95% of all viewers in the entire, newly-coined Naga Protectorate of the New Reformer are currently watching your feed!
achievements.reward: You have received a Legendary Fan Box! This box will only be voted on by viewers in the Naga system.

achievements.name: You now tread in the realm of gods
achievements.text: New Achievement! You now tread in the realm of gods! You’ve trained a skill past 15 using battlefield conditions, as opposed to just taking a bunch of potions to do it. That’s quite the accomplishment. I’d ramble on and on about this, but you’re currently a babbling idiot with your bare feet buried in an All-Tree root. […]
achievements.reward: The skill is the reward. The good news is this level-16 Mind Balance Skill will now wake your ass up.

achievements.name: Bomb's Away
achievements.text: New Achievement. Bomb's Away! You dropped a metric fuck ton of bombs from your own inventory while you were floating in midair! There's this phrase that goes something like I dropped everything to come help you. For you, this was quite literal. It's always fun when we truly discover what someone's weakness is. […]
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Payload Box!

achievements.name: Come to Daddy
achievements.text: New Achievement. Come to Daddy. You were offered an exit deal. You rejected it. You like me. You didn’t leave me the first chance you got. You’re not like those ungrateful wannabe assholes who are running away from the playground just because they can. Well, good riddance, I say. But not you. Not good ol’ Carl. Good. Good boy.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Daddy’s Little Secret Box.

achievements.name: Default Winner
achievements.text: New Achievement! Default Winner! Wyndham Halswelle. Óscar Pereiro. Suzette Charles. Montell Griffin. All “winners.” They received top honors in their sport or event, but that victory was marred because someone else had to get disqualified for them to win. This is you, Mr. Winner of Faction Wars. Sure, you’ve won, but I can’t imagine it’s satisfying. Honestly, I blame myself. […]

achievements.name: Wastrel
achievements.for: Feeding the Enchanted Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering to Donut
achievements.text: New Achievement! Wastrel. Wow. Frank Q went out of his way to give you one of the most powerful items in this game, and what do you do with it? You feed it to a fucking cat? What a damned waste.
achievements.reward: Fuck off.

achievements.name: B'sieging
achievements.text: You've used siege equipment to zero in and attack a boss monster from afar. That's cheating! It's like trying to kill someone with a bomb. What a bitch move!
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Siege Master Box!

achievements.name: Bisected
achievements.text: You teleported into a solid object. Congratulations. You've lost your... Oh, wait! You were teleported due to an administrative action. That means your privileged ass was saved. Again. No missing arm or leg. No dungeon-style circumcision. Nothing. Boy, you must really bring in the cheddar for them to keep coddling you like this. Teleport mishaps are funny as shit. You ever see The Fly? […]
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Lucky Bastard box!

achievements.name: Desecrated
achievements.text: You have found a desecrated temple! That means all the temple's attendants have been murdered. The temple's treasury has been looted. The sacred wine has probably been all lapped up, too. And this used to be a nice town. It hasn't been the same since you guys moved in. If you are an adherent of this temple, you may no longer worship here. […]
achievements.reward: You entered a building. You don't get a reward for that. It's not like you kicked it up a notch by defiling the shrine. Oh, wait.

achievements.name: Disarming Personality
achievements.text: You ripped a fellow crawler's arm off! With your bare hands! Holy shit!
achievements.reward: You received a Silver Savage Box!

achievements.name: Double-Billed
achievements.for: Appearing on two Shows at the same time
achievements.text: You are one of the first five crawlers to receive double-billing! I bet you don't know what that means. This is similar to switch-overs, but this time it's on purpose. I bet that didn't help at all.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box!

achievements.name: Extinction Event
achievements.for: Killing every member of a non-unique species
achievements.text: New Achievement! Extinction Event. You have, with a single attack, killed every last member of a non-unique species on a dungeon’s floor. That’s not an easy thing to do, and it takes a special brand of asshole to pull something like this off. Species killed: Wall Monitor.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Asshole's Box!

achievements.name: Fight the Power
achievements.for: Codefendants in a lawsuit with the System AI
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fight the Power! (x7) I’m not repeating this shit over and over, but you got seven of these bad boys all at the same time. You and I have been named co-defendants in an action brought to the Syndicate Court by a third party, and we have been deemed—drum roll please—victorious! Why did they sue us? If you don’t already know why, you probably will never know. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Summary Judgement Box! (x7)

achievements.name: Gavrilo Princip
achievements.text: When Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion died a few hours back, it certainly caused a ripple or two out in the galaxy. But in the end, the death of half the Lemig council isn’t that big of a deal. Their governmental system is idiotic, yes, but all the parts are interchangeable. […]
achievements.reward: You’ve just received a Legendary 1914 Box!

achievements.name: I'll Take the Ceramic Dalmatian, Pat!
achievements.text: You have discovered a Reward Room! Scattered throughout the dungeon, reward rooms offer crawlers items generally not available within loot boxes. Most reward rooms only allow one choice. So, if you're in a party of multiple people, tell them I said you should get the prize, not them.
achievements.reward: Don't be a greedy bitch. The goddammed room is the reward.

achievements.name: Insurgent
achievements.for: Leaving an explosive trap that killed a target
achievements.text: You left an explosive device along a well-traveled path, and it detonated and killed an intended target. It was really cool. Too bad you didn't get to see it because you're a trap-leaving bitch!
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Trapmaster Box!

achievements.name: It itches when I pee
achievements.for: Infecting another combatant with a venereal disease
achievements.text: New Achievement! It itches when I pee! You infected another combatant with a venereal disease. Good job there, Derek Jeter. I hope you bought them dinner first.
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze condom. Use it next time.

achievements.name: Loner
achievements.text: New achievement! Loner. You entered the dungeon without any human companions. Didn't anyone teach you there is safety in numbers?
achievements.reward: None! Haha. You are so dead.

achievements.name: Man of God
achievements.text: Ever since that first monkey looked up into the sky and saw something twinkling up there, you meat puppets have tried to force twenty pounds of existential meaning into a ten pound sack of chaos. You have found religion! You have pledged yourself to a life of worship and piety! Finally. now there are consequences for all of your actions!
achievements.reward: One of the greatest things about having a religion is the unshakeable certainty that you're right and everyone else who doesn't believe the same as you is wrong! That's a pretty good reward. Oh, and don't forget about the eternal life thing, too. That's always on of their big selling points.

achievements.name: Mass Casualty Event
achievements.for: Killing more than 250 non-Mob casualties in an attack
achievements.text: Okay. Calm your man-tiddies. Did your mother not love you? Is your god promising you unlimited handjobs in heaven or something? You planted and then detonated an improvised explosive device within an urban population center that resulted in more than 250 non-mob casualties. You've done this a few times now, but this was a big one. And on purpose. You really know how to paint the town red.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: Menagerie
achievements.text: You have discovered a pet reward room. From caterpillars who secrete vodka to basilisks who can turn mobs to stone, a good pet can make the difference between survival and the end of the road. Just remember what happened with Harambe. There ain't no zookeepers around to shoot the monster's ass if you bite off more than you can chew.
achievements.reward: You have a key. It opens only one cage. Figure it out, Einstein.

achievements.name: Pincushioned
achievements.text: New Achievement! Pincushioned! You’ve had both your eyeballs pierced at the same time! I don’t really have anything snappy to say about that. Just... holy fucking shit that was gnarly. You’re lucky your eyes didn’t explode!
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum That-Was-Disgusting Box!

achievements.name: Podophilia!
achievements.for: Stomping on Goblin with bare feet
achievements.text: You've used your bare feet to crush and kill an opponent! Hey! That's my fetish. Seriously. Keep doing it, and you'll be rewarded. This will help.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Shoe Box!

achievements.name: Premature Questjaculation
achievements.for: Beating a Quest before it can be given
achievements.text: You beat a quest before I could even give it to you! Anticipating what's going to happen is one thing, but this is just ridiculous. It's like arriving in your pants before your date can even untie their shoelaces. Pathetic.
achievements.reward: You get nothing! And you would've received a good quest box, too!

achievements.name: Sex Pervert
achievements.text: A nipple ring? Really? The next thing you know, you'll be waxing your perineum and attending those parties where you have to put your keys in a bowl. You'll have to grow out your sideburns, buy a Trans Am, and you'll no longer be able to make eye contact with your child's orthodontist.
achievements.reward: Whores don't get rewards.

achievements.name: Temple Defiler
achievements.for: Desecrating a Temple with ones own flesh
achievements.text: You've defiled a temple's sacred shrine by breaking it with your own flesh! Wow. I dunno, man. That's pretty ballsy. There are a lot of bad things people can do when they're in church. They can swear. They can ogle the hot nuns. They can pinch the eucharist wafers and use them as poker chips. They can rip pages from the hymnals and roll them into joints. […]
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Apostate Box!

achievements.name: Uprooted
achievements.text: You caused a Rooted-in-Place boss monster to move. That's no easy feat. You then killed that monster. Pretty impressive. Hope you remember how you did it.
achievements.reward: You already got a boss box. This achievement is the reward.

achievements.name: You've Entered a Guildhall!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve entered a guildhall! Congratulations. You know how to open doors.
achievements.reward: That sense of fulfillment you feel? That’s reward enough.
